name: Overland Park

neighborhoods.name: Downtown Overland Park
neighborhoods.homes: older small houses and newer apartment buildings

housing: Overland Park's rentals are mostly suburban single-family houses, townhomes and large apartment complexes, with newer homes in the south of the city.
climate: Test the furnace and air conditioning, and photograph the roof and siding for hail damage; storms are common and winters are cold.
fact: Overland Park's rental inspections look only at the outside of the building, so a tenant's own move-in record is the main proof of the inside.
